title: feuilleea serianthes
intro: Feuilleea serianthes, commonly known as Philippine water lily or Kamalaya, is a medicinal plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. This aquatic plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified through various studies. Feuilleea serianthes has been traditionally used in folk medicine to alleviate various ailments, making it a valuable resource for natural remedies.
